messages:
OncallBot: ALERT: canary-failure-high-5xx — increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (canary deploy: canary/2024-05-01-12). Trigger: error-rate > 3% for 2m. paging Priya (oncall).

Priya: oncall here, seeing dashboards. spike around 12:34 UTC. starting investigation.

Alex: I deployed the small tokenizer tweak in canary yesterday (commit abcd1234). rolling back to previous commit could be fastest.

Priya: good signal. can you check canary logs (link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/canary/2024-05-01-12) and dump recent errors?

OncallBot: Metrics snapshot: canary 5xx = 3.8% (baseline prod 0.2%), p50 latency +22ms. Top error: RuntimeError: tokenization mismatch -> 87% of 5xx.

Sam: grabbing logs now. tail shows repeated tokenizer assertion failures on long inputs > 8k tokens. looks like new tokenizer path mishandles large buffers.

Diana: tagging CS - @Eva (CS) — any customer reports yet?

Eva (CS): we have one high-priority customer on a dedicated plan who reported increased failed requests for batch generation earlier. CS is drafting an incident email. will update if they escalate.

Priya: impact: canary only so far, but we should stop the canary rollout and kill the feature flag for the new tokenizer to prevent further rollout. Alex, can you flip the flag and/or revert commit?

Alex: will do both. killing flag now: `redwoodctl feature-flag set experiment/new-tokenizer false --env=canary`

Alex: flag command returned success. forcing immediate canary rollback: `git revert --no-edit abcd1234 && git push origin main && deploybot trigger canary-rollback --ref=main~1`

OncallBot: deploybot: rollback job started (job id: jb-5492). monitoring canary traffic.

Sam: running sanity check on staging with long inputs, appears stable with previous tokenizer.

OncallBot: deploybot: rollback completed 12:47 UTC. canary 5xx dropped to 0.3% within 90s.

Priya: verified metrics and tail logs, no tokenizer assertions anymore. marking immediate mitigation complete.

Eva (CS): sent update to affected customer: short note explaining canary issue and rollback, offering follow-up. customer acknowledged, no P1 escalation.

Alex: created a tiny hotfix PR to guard the tokenizer path on long inputs and added unit + integration test for >8k tokens. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/+/PR-2789. will not rush into prod; propose patch to canary after tests pass.

Sam: leaving a small post-deploy checklist: (1) follow up on root cause rollback record, (2) add synthetic test for long inputs in CI, (3) schedule a postmortem if this reaches customers or reoccurs.

Priya: sounds good. incident severity = Sev2 (canary-only, limited customer reports, rollback successful). Handoff: Sam will be follow-up owner for remediation and test coverage, I'll clear the oncall paging.

OncallBot: Incident update posted to #incidents-log. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

Alex: FYI commit reverted: abcd1234 (revert commit ef12cd34). small hotfix PR opened; will coordinate with QA. :thumbsup:

Eva (CS): follow-up task created in CS queue to check customer behavior tomorrow and link to incident.

Priya: thanks team. closing thread for active mitigation. if anything new pops, please reopen here or ping me directly.

Sam: taking follow-up. I'll create a short writeup with root cause and test plan by EOD.

OncallBot: Handoff: next on-call (Sam) acknowledged.
